messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: LIVEPAGE: inference-streaming p99 in us-east-1 crossed 2.5s for 10+ min. Auto-paging to oncall. Links: https://dash.redwood/p/streams?region=us-east-1

alyssa (oncall): I'm on it. Grabbed the p95/p99 table — p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 2.9s, tail spikes up to 6s for streaming responses. Streaming stalls showing replays and token gaps.

max (sre): seeing a correlated spike in control-plane configfetch latencies. Many requests to /v1/config?env=prod are getting 429/503 around the same window. Sample logs: 
```
2024-06-11T18:06:12Z INFO http-request path=/v1/config status=429 rt=3250ms x-client=internal
2024-06-11T18:06:12Z WARN auth: token-verify backend delayed 1200ms
```

samir (infra): database connection counts on config-store jumped. Pg stats: active connections 480 (max 500), long-running queries in pg_stat_activity mostly from feature-flag evaluator joins. 

nina (platform): a recent feature rollout (ff:exp-stream-cache) started ramping to 40% 25m ago. That flag causes clients to fetch full config blobs more frequently instead of using local TTL. Could be amplification.

alyssa (oncall): customer impact: multiple SaaS customers reported slow streaming responses and some timeouts. Support is starting to get tickets. We'll need a short customer statement if mitigation takes >30m.

lisa (support): pls paste a short blurb we can reuse. Customers asking ETA.

max (sre): triage notes — inference path calls control-plane for config & auth metadata on start of stream. If configfetch is slow or throttled, token exchange stalls and streaming stalls. Root cause likely combination of feature flag rollout increasing config churn + auth service rate-limits backing up due to DB contention.

samir (infra): running a quick explain on the flagged query — looks like a sequential scan on feature_flags table for the new evaluator join. Query sample: 
```
SELECT f.key, r.rules FROM feature_flags f JOIN releases r ON r.flag_id = f.id WHERE f.enabled AND f.segment @> $1;
```
Plan shows seq scan 95% because missing index on segment column.

pradeep (eng): I can push a hotfix to the platform SDK to respect cached TTL for existing sessions and stop full-blob fetches. But that's a code change — need quick mitigations first.

max (sre): quick mitigations we can do now: 
- abort the feature flag rollout (target -> 0%) to stop amplification
- increase config-service rate-limit quota for regional control-plane (temporary)
- apply DB connection pooling tweak (pgbouncer) to limit long-running queries
- enable config cache fallback in edge routing to serve last-known config for 60s

nina (platform): rolling the flag back now (started). patching feature flag config to 0% ramp.

samir (infra): I can bump pgbouncer pool size and recycle a few app instances to drain long queries. Doing pgbouncer restart in us-east-1 pool now.

db-sre-bot: scaling read replica set +1 in us-east-1 (request id r-20240611-03). ETA ~ 3m.

db-sre-bot: read replica added and catchup complete. Observability: replication lag < 200ms.

max (sre): applied temporary rate-limit increase on control-plane edge for internal clients (x-client: internal) — doubled quota for 15m. Keep monitoring.

alyssa (oncall): support blurb draft: "We're investigating elevated latency affecting streaming responses in us-east-1. We've identified a control-plane config service load spike and are rolling back a recent feature rollout while we stabilize. We'll update within 30 minutes. Apologies for the disruption." -- ok to send?

lisa (support): sending now. thanks. :thumbsup:

pradeep (eng): pushed SDK fallback config change to stop full-blob fetch behaviour for new sessions (hotpatch to edge client). Deploying canary 5% in us-east-1.

max (sre): seeing p99 fall from 2.9s -> 1.6s after flag rollback + rate-limit bump + read replica. Tail still has occasional spikes ~3s. Could be in-flight streams that already blocked on token exchange.

samir (infra): cleared long-running queries and applied index suggestion to feature_flags.segment, will schedule proper migration tomorrow. For now added a small index hint on hot node.

nina (platform): can we enable the config TTL fallback globally for 60s via a config flag? That should reduce burst fetches while infra stabilizes.

max (sre): enabled TTL fallback via runtime toggle in us-east-1. Confirmed by logs: now serving cached config for 92% of requests.

alyssa (oncall): Customer impact update: tickets slowed, no new timeouts in last 8 minutes. p95 ~ 380ms, p99 ~ 1.4s. Still watching for spikes.

pradeep (eng): can take the oncall at 19:00 UTC. I'll continue to monitor and follow up with a postmortem action list: index migration, SDK TTL change permanent, add control-plane autoscale rule for configload, improve rollout guardrails for flag that triggers fetch amplification.

alyssa (oncall): handoff to pradeep for next phase. Summary for next oncall: 
- root cause: feature flag rollout caused high-configfetch churn + sequential scan in feature_flags causing DB contention -> auth & config rate-limits tripped -> inference streaming stalls
- mitigations applied: rolled flag to 0%, bumped internal rate-limits, scaled read replica, enabled TTL fallback, applied pgbouncer tweaks, deployed SDK fallback canary
- customer comms: support blurb sent, escalation open with key customers X/Y/Z (support has list)
- next steps: finish index migration, run a controlled rollout test for SDK change, add autoscale rule and improve alerting thresholds for configfetch p99

pradeep (eng): acknowledged. taking over livepage. I'll keep thread updated and will open an action ticket in the infra backlog.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Livepage acknowledged by pradeep. Handoff complete.

alyssa (oncall): marking this as stabilized for oncall handoff. If regressions appear, please ping this thread and we'll re-open. Thanks team!
